info.name: Decidiq Embargo and Confidentiality Contract Suite
info.description: Newman contract tests for embargo-geheimhouding (REQ-EMB-005): the public ORI documents feed leaves out a document under an imposed confidentiality restriction and a document whose embargo is still active, lists a released one, and lists a document again once its restriction is dissolved. Run with --env-var baseUrl=<instance> --env-var adminUser=<user> --env-var adminPass=<password>; there is no default instance. Section 3 covers the impose, ratify and lift endpoints (REQ-EMB-001, -003, -004): 401, 400 and 422 on impose, an imposed paper with no classifier write, 400 and 422 on ratify, 409 on lifting before ratification and 404 on an unknown restriction.

item.name: 3. Impose, ratify and lift through decidiq
item.description: embargo-geheimhouding REQ-EMB-001, REQ-EMB-003 and REQ-EMB-004: the guarded endpoints. Runs after section 2, so the plain document has no restriction yet.

exec: pm.test('Impose: 422 on a ground that does not exist', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
pm.test('Impose: the restriction is imposed on the document', () => {
pm.test('Impose: a paper has no classifier of its own', () => pm.expect(b.classifier).to.eql('not-needed'));
pm.test('Impose: the ground needs ratification, so placement was tried', () => pm.expect(b.ratification).to.be.oneOf(['placed', 'no-meeting']));
pm.test('Ratify: 422 on a decision that does not exist', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
